title: Russian strikes kill nine in Ukraine and damage historic cathedral, officials say
description: A Ukrainian drone attack in the Russian city of Tula, south of Moscow, killed three people and wounded three others.

title: White House hosts "UFC Freedom 250" fight on Trump's 80th birthday
description: The UFC is hosting a fight series on the White House South Lawn Sunday night.

title: The 2026 FIFA World Cup schedule and how to watch
description: With 104 World Cup games being played in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, it's like "a Super Bowl every single day for five weeks," U.S. team captain Tim Ream told CBS News.

title: Carolina Hurricanes win second Stanley Cup, beating Vegas in 6 games
description: The Golden Knights had taken a two-games-to-one lead in the Stanley Cup Finals, but Carolina came roaring back, winning three straight to take home their first championship since the 2005-2006 season.

title: Chael Sonnen Has 6-Word Reaction to Michael Chandler’s UFC Freedom 250 Loss
description: Chael Sonnen had a strong suggestion for Michael Chandler after his UFC Freedom 250 loss to Mauricio Ruffy, and many fans agreed.

title: Somali World Cup referee blocked from US to receive full pay from FIFA
description: The Somali World Cup referee who had been blocked from entering the United States will receive his full pay for the matches he would have officiated.
